tools.name: financialcents_list_clients
tools.description: List the firm's clients with name, company and archive status. Use search_field, search_operation and search_value to find one client, and page to read more. Financial Cents API: GET /clients.

tools.name: financialcents_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id, with its contacts and archive status. Financial Cents API: GET /clients/{client_id}.

tools.name: financialcents_list_client_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts (name, email, phone, mobile, address) that belong to one client. Financial Cents API: GET /clients/{client_id}/contacts.

tools.name: financialcents_list_client_resources
tools.description: List the resources (labelled links) attached to one client. Financial Cents API: GET /clients/{client_id}/resources.

tools.name: financialcents_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts across all clients, with the client each one belongs to. Use the search options to find a person by name or email. Financial Cents API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: financialcents_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id. Financial Cents API: GET /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: financialcents_list_projects
tools.description: List client projects with title, client, due date, billing rate and closed status. Use the search options to find one project. Financial Cents API: GET /projects.

tools.name: financialcents_list_project_resources
tools.description: List the resources (labelled links) attached to one project. Financial Cents API: GET /projects/{project_id}/resources.

tools.name: financialcents_list_templates
tools.description: List the project templates the firm can create projects from. Use one template id with financialcents_create_project_from_template. Financial Cents API: GET /templates.

tools.name: financialcents_list_users
tools.description: List the team members of the firm, with their ids for use as reviewer or agent ids. Financial Cents API: GET /users.

tools.name: financialcents_create_client
tools.description: Create a new client. Optionally add a first contact with contact_name, contact_email, contact_address and contact_notes. Financial Cents API: POST /clients.

tools.name: financialcents_update_client
tools.description: Change the display name of one client. Financial Cents API: PUT /clients/{client_id}.

tools.name: financialcents_create_client_contact
tools.description: Add a contact to one client. Financial Cents API: POST /clients/{client_id}/contacts.

tools.name: financialcents_update_contact
tools.description: Change the details of one contact. Only the fields you pass are sent. Financial Cents API: PUT /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: financialcents_create_project_from_template
tools.description: Create a project from one template. Optionally set the title, the client_id and the reviewer_id. Use financialcents_list_templates for template ids. Financial Cents API: POST /templates/{template_id}/projects.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: financialcents_list_client_contacts, financialcents_list_contacts · Private data: financialcents_get_client, financialcents_list_client_contacts, financialcents_list_contacts, financialcents_get_contact, financialcents_create_client, financialcents_create_client_contact, financialcents_update_contact · Public sink: financialcents_list_client_contacts, financialcents_list_contacts, financialcents_create_client, financialcents_create_client_contact, financialcents_create_project_from_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: financialcents_list_client_contacts, financialcents_list_contacts · Private data: financialcents_get_client, financialcents_list_client_contacts, financialcents_list_contacts, financialcents_get_contact, financialcents_create_client, financialcents_create_client_contact, financialcents_update_contact · Public sink: financialcents_list_client_contacts, financialcents_list_contacts, financialcents_create_client, financialcents_create_client_contact, financialcents_create_project_from_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
